main_text.p: ut الله lillahi, pro الله Deo.

Si dictio praecedens terminetur consona ea adsumit Kesram, ut [illegible, ~8 letters] dara-bati Iommo, verberavit mater. Sed termina-tiones verbales, [illegible, ~3 letters] & [illegible, ~3 letters] itemque affixa [illegible, ~5 letters] & [illegible, ~3 letters] assumunt Damma, ut [illegible, ~6 letters] gazawo ladova, oppugnarunt hostem. Praepositio [illegible, ~4 letters] a & affixa [illegible, ~2 letters], & [illegible, ~2 letters] pri-mae personae singularis Fatham, ut [illegible, ~8 letters] darabania Imuallimo verberavit me praeceptor.

Si vocalis nunnata praecedat ante articulum [illegible, ~3 letters] abjicit Nun, ut [illegible, ~9 letters] beito Imukaddafo, domus sanctificata, pro [illegible, ~5 letters] beiton. Alibi vero retinet, & Elif unionis li-cet vocalem non habeat adscriptam, tamen

page.notes: Arabic script throughout; the vowel marks and several word forms are not legible enough to copy letter by letter, so the Arabic examples are marked illegible. The line "ut الله lillahi, pro الله Deo." opens with a fragment from the previous page. Catchword "pro-" is printed at the lower right. No running head or signature is printed.
